messages:
maria_g: FYI customer reported a massive embed billing spike. They say dashboard shows ~8.4k embed units for yesterday but invoice shows 48.1k. Customer: ACME-Analytics. They want a refund and an explanation.
jordan_support: ack. Do we have the request IDs or example embedding job payloads from their account? thread #12345 in Zendesk.
samir_finance: grabbing invoice INV-2026-09-ACME now. Ledger shows 48,120 embed units billed at 0.0004 each. Need to confirm metering source before any refund.
billing-bot: Automated metering log for acct acme-123: 2026-03-03 02:12:45 to 2026-03-03 03:10:12, total_embed_units=48120, source=embed-stream-v2, dedupe_key=null
maria_g: billing-bot shows dedupe_key=null — suspicious. Customer says they ran a single batch job (one POST with 7500 inputs). Something doubled/tripled.
ops_infra: I pulled request logs. There's a pattern: same client_request_id sent 3x within 2s window but with missing Idempotency header when they retried. Our streaming endpoint currently uses a short-lived dedupe cache keyed on idempotency header; if header missing we fallback to per-connection sequence dedupe which fails across rapid reconnects. Repro steps I used:

```
# simulate failing retry without Idempotency-Key
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"embed-compact-v2","inputs":[...7500 items...]}'
  sleep 0.8
done
```

In logs those three requests show as distinct meter events because no idempotency header and ephemeral connection id changed.
jordan_support: so billing credited to embed-stream-v2 path instead of batch-commit. Is there automatic coalescing for duplicate streams? ops_infra: not if idempotency header absent. Also found an internal bug: when connection reset happens during stream ACK we emitted both stream and fallback batch metering events for the same work (duplicate counting). I traced emitted events: 1 stream event + 1 batch-retry event per retry. That explains ~6x multiplier in worst cases.
samir_finance: can you quantify how many duplicates for acme? ops_infra: for acme-123 I see original 7,512 inputs. Meter recorded: stream_events_count = 3 (each ~7,512) and batch_retry_events_count = 3 -> total 6x => 45,072 units + small overhead = 48,120 billed.
maria_g: customer is requesting immediate reversal of overcharge and compensation for engineering time. What are suggested next steps?
samir_finance: propose immediate partial credit: reverse duplicate delta = 40,608 units (~$16.24). We should also apply a goodwill credit of $200 for disruption, and create a revrec adjustment note referencing RC-234. Create journal entry code JE-23456 for accounting. Need ops confirmation on root cause before posting.
ops_infra: agreed. I'll open infra-issue INF-2026 to patch dedupe behavior and add server-side correlation using client_request_id fallback. Also will add a retroactive dedupe pass to mark duplicate meter events from 2026-03-03.
jordan_support: I'll draft a reply to ACME: explain duplicate counting bug, outline refund of $216.24 (approx), timeline 48-72h for ledger update, and ask for any example payloads if they want deeper postmortem.
maria_g: please confirm exact refund amount once finance posts the credit. Samir, can you file the revrec note and attach INF-2026 when done?
samir_finance: filing JE and RevRec now. RevRec note: "RC-234: customer embed metering duplicates due to streaming/batch fallback on connection retries. Credit delta: 40,608 embed units. Goodwill credit: $200. Total credit: $216.24. Accounting code: ACCT-CUST-CREDIT, JE-23456. Revenue impact will be recognized in next close as contra-revenue; please coordinate with RevRec team."
billing-bot: Credit action queued: type=partial_refund, acct=acme-123, units=40608, amount=16.24, goodwill=200.00, total=216.24, status=pending
ops_infra: I'll add a postmortem blurb to INF-2026 and schedule a patch deploy (hotfix) to change dedupe to prefer client_request_id when available, and to suppress double-metering on fallback paths. Also adding a daily audit job to detect >2x deltas between invoice and dashboard for early detection.
jordan_support: I'll notify ACME with the planned refund and hotfix timeline. Also offering to run a joint test with them after fix.
maria_g: thanks team. follow-ups: ops to close INF-2026, finance to post JE-23456 and update RevRec, support to confirm with customer when credit posts. I'll update zendesk #12345 with status. :thumbsup:
